title: IELTS Task 2 大作文母题库
source_note: 252 道题干整理自用户提供的九分学长写作题库，其中 4 处明显语法或标点错误已规范化；27 个母题、范文、逻辑链与表达均为 Sage Path 教研内容，不代表官方考频或官方评分样文。

topics.summary_zh: 处理教育究竟应培养什么、由谁负责、怎样教以及资源如何分配。
topics.framework_zh: 公平与效率、通识与专精、知识与就业能力、教师/家庭/制度的责任边界
topics.stance_zh: 大学应把学术基础与就业能力结合起来，而不是把二者理解为非此即彼。
topics.thesis_en: Universities should preserve rigorous academic study while embedding transferable skills and authentic workplace application in the curriculum.
topics.conclusion_en: A blended model best protects the long-term value of higher education because knowledge supplies depth while practical application turns that knowledge into adaptable capability.

logic_chains.title_zh: 学术深度形成长期迁移
logic_chains.claim_en: Academic study develops the conceptual depth needed to solve unfamiliar problems.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 原理与证据训练让学生面对新情境时能够推理，而不是只会复现固定流程。
logic_chains.example_en: A student who understands statistical reasoning can evaluate evidence in many industries rather than operate one software package only.
logic_chains.result_en: Deep knowledge therefore remains useful even when particular jobs and tools change.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 不能把‘学术’写成脱离现实；应说明它如何支撑判断与创新。

logic_chains.title_zh: 真实任务缩短就业落差
logic_chains.claim_en: Applied projects convert abstract knowledge into demonstrable professional competence.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 项目、实习和合作任务要求学生沟通、分工并交付结果，补上课堂与工作的落差。
logic_chains.example_en: Engineering students who design a low-cost water filter must combine theory, budgeting and teamwork.
logic_chains.result_en: Graduates enter employment with both subject knowledge and evidence that they can use it.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 职业训练应是课程的一部分，而非把大学降格为短期岗位培训班。

logic_chains.title_zh: 差异化课程兼顾公平
logic_chains.claim_en: A flexible curriculum allows students with different goals to reach demanding outcomes through different routes.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 核心课程守住质量，选修与支持课程则回应能力、兴趣和资源差异。
logic_chains.example_en: Universities can require academic writing while offering extra language workshops and vocational electives.
logic_chains.result_en: More students gain access without lowering the standard of the final qualification.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 差异化不是降低要求，最终学习成果仍应透明一致。

logic_chains.title_zh: 教师与家庭形成支持网络
logic_chains.claim_en: Learning improves when schools, teachers and families have complementary responsibilities.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 学校提供专业教学，家庭塑造习惯，制度保障资源；任何一方单独承担都会出现盲区。
logic_chains.example_en: Regular feedback shared with parents can identify weak attendance before it becomes academic failure.
logic_chains.result_en: Early coordination prevents small learning problems from becoming permanent disadvantage.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 年长学生需要更多自主权，家庭参与不应变成控制。

expressions.en: build a foundation of transferable knowledge
bridge the gap between theory and practice
expressions.zh: 弥合理论与实践的差距

pitfalls_zh: 只罗列课程名称，没有解释能力如何形成。
把学术与就业写成绝对对立，缺少融合方案。
讨论教育公平时只写免费，忽略教学质量与支持方式。

prompts.prompt: It is the responsibility of schools to teach children good behavior in addition to providing formal education. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
In some countries, many people choose to educate their children at home by themselves instead of sending them to school. Do you think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
Many students find it harder to study at university or college compared to when they were in grade school. Why is this? What are some possible solutions to this problem?
Children can learn effectively by watching television. Therefore, they should be encouraged to watch television both at home and at school. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Education, from preschool through university, should be paid for by the government and therefore free to students. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Childcare training courses should be mandatory for all parents. Do you agree or disagree with this statement?

University students always focus on one specialist subject, but some people think universities should encourage their students to study a range of subjects in addition to their own subjects. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
University courses should focus more on future developments rather than the past. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
The government should invest more money in teaching science rather than other subjects to help a country make progress and develop. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Everybody should stay at school until they are 18 years old. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

It is better for a country to spend money on skills training and vocational training for practical work (e.g. car maintenance, hairdressing) than on university education. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Many believe that the traditional educational system of teachers and students in a classroom will be replaced by 2050. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view?
All university students should do some voluntary work to help the local community. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Art classes, like painting and drawing, are as important as other subjects, so they should be a compulsory subject in high school. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people believe that the main purpose of school is to turn children into good citizens and workers instead of benefiting them individually. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some teachers think that international student exchange would be beneficial for all teenage school students. Do you think its advantages will outweigh the disadvantages?
Some people think adults should learn practical skills by themselves, while others believe that learning from a teacher in a classroom is better. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Scientists say that junk food is harmful to people's health. Some people think that the answer to this problem is to educate people. Others think education will not work. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Some people think that language should be taught in small classes, while others think the number of students in a language class does not matter. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
In schools and universities, girls tend to choose the arts, while boys like science. What are the reasons for this trend? Do you think this tendency should be changed?
Despite better access to education, many adults today still cannot read or write. In what ways are they disadvantaged? What can governments do to help them?
Nowadays, not enough students choose science subjects at university in many countries. Why is this? What effect does this have on society?

Some people think that schools should select students according to their academic abilities, while others believe that it is better to have students with different abilities studying together. Discuss both views and state your own opinion.
Some people say that children should go to school as young as possible, while others believe that children should go to school at least 7 years old. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Some people think that older school children should learn a wide range of subjects to acquire more knowledge, while other people believe they should learn a small number of subjects in detail. Discuss both views and give your opinions.

Many people believe that healthy eating and the importance of healthy food should be taught in school. Others say that parents should teach their children about healthy food and diet. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Some people think that the best way to be successful in life is to get a university education. Others disagree and say this is no longer true. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Some people believe that university education should focus on skills for employment in the future. Others think they should focus only on academic study. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

representative_prompt.prompt: Some people believe that university education should focus on skills for employment in the future. Others think they should focus only on academic study. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

topics.summary_zh: 分析儿童的行为、能力与价值观如何受家庭、学校、同伴和数字环境共同影响。
topics.framework_zh: 自主与保护、短期表现与长期发展、家庭/学校/同伴影响
topics.stance_zh: 电脑游戏本身并非完全有害，但占用运动、睡眠和现实互动时，整体发展将明显受损。
topics.thesis_en: Computer games can offer limited cognitive and social value, but their dominance over exercise and face-to-face play is a negative development.
topics.conclusion_en: Children benefit most when adults shape a balanced environment instead of either prohibiting digital play or allowing it to displace every offline activity.

logic_chains.title_zh: 便利与即时反馈吸引儿童
logic_chains.claim_en: Digital games hold children's attention through convenience, rapid rewards and visible progress.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 低进入成本和连续奖励比需要场地、同伴与耐心的户外运动更容易形成习惯。
logic_chains.example_en: A child can begin a new game within seconds, whereas organising football may depend on weather, transport and several friends.
logic_chains.result_en: Screen play gradually becomes the default leisure choice even without a deliberate decision.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 原因解释不能等同于道德谴责；要呈现环境如何塑造选择。

logic_chains.title_zh: 运动缺失影响身心发展
logic_chains.claim_en: Replacing physical play with prolonged sitting weakens both health and emotional regulation.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 运动提供体能负荷、现实反馈和压力释放，这些功能无法由屏幕完全替代。
logic_chains.example_en: Regular team sport improves stamina while teaching children to manage frustration after a loss.
logic_chains.result_en: Balanced activity supports concentration, sleep and resilience in other parts of life.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 适量游戏不必被禁止，关键是总时长与替代效应。

logic_chains.title_zh: 自主需要逐步放权
logic_chains.claim_en: Age-appropriate autonomy helps children learn judgement rather than merely obey rules.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 在可控范围内选择并承担后果，才能把外部纪律转化为自我管理。
logic_chains.example_en: A teenager who plans a weekly leisure schedule can see how late gaming affects sleep and schoolwork.
logic_chains.result_en: Guided choice prepares young people for decisions that parents cannot supervise forever.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 低龄儿童或高风险行为仍需要清晰边界。

logic_chains.title_zh: 多方环境共同塑造行为
logic_chains.claim_en: Parents, schools and peers influence different layers of a child's development.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 家庭建立日常习惯，学校提供结构化机会，同伴决定行为是否被群体强化。
logic_chains.example_en: A school sports club is more effective when parents protect attendance time and friends participate together.
logic_chains.result_en: Aligned signals make healthy routines easier to maintain.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 不能把结果归因于单一主体，也不能因此模糊主要责任。

pitfalls_zh: 把所有儿童当成同一年龄和自控水平。
只有‘家长要管’，没有说明规则怎样发挥作用。
把短期成绩直接等同于长期成长。

More government money should be spent on free-time activities for young people. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Children who commit serious crimes should be punished as adults. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
It is important to give children the chance to act independently and make their own decisions from early age. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this idea?

Nowadays young people spend too much of their free time in shopping malls. This has negative effects on themselves and the society they live in. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement.

Some people believe that children who commit crimes should be punished. Others think that their parents should be punished instead. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

topics.summary_zh: 讨论工时、地点、薪酬、稳定性和个人意义如何共同决定工作质量。
topics.framework_zh: 生产率与福祉、稳定与流动、激励与公平、个人选择与雇主责任
topics.stance_zh: 限制过度工时总体是积极政策，因为它矫正劳资权力差异并降低长期健康与安全成本。
topics.thesis_en: Legal limits on working hours are a positive safeguard, provided that they preserve flexibility for genuine emergencies and employee choice.
topics.conclusion_en: Reasonable limits make employment more sustainable without preventing firms from using transparent, compensated flexibility when circumstances truly require it.

logic_chains.title_zh: 权力不对等导致过度工时
logic_chains.claim_en: Employees may accept excessive hours because refusing an employer carries financial or career risk.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 劳动合同并不总是平等协商，尤其在失业率高或零工岗位中。
logic_chains.example_en: A junior employee may work repeated unpaid evenings to avoid appearing uncommitted.
logic_chains.result_en: A legal ceiling turns rest from a personal request into an enforceable minimum.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 高自主、高薪岗位可有弹性，但仍需自愿和补偿。

logic_chains.title_zh: 疲劳产生隐性社会成本
logic_chains.claim_en: Chronic overwork reduces productivity and shifts health costs beyond the workplace.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 疲劳增加错误、事故和慢性疾病，企业短期得到的工时可能由医疗与离职成本抵消。
logic_chains.example_en: A fatigued driver or nurse can endanger other people, not merely reduce personal comfort.
logic_chains.result_en: Shorter, focused schedules can protect output while lowering preventable harm.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 工时减少若没有流程改善，也可能只是把任务压缩进更短时间。

logic_chains.title_zh: 职业流动提升匹配效率
logic_chains.claim_en: Changing jobs can improve the match between a worker's skills, values and responsibilities.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 流动让劳动者离开低成长岗位，也促使雇主改善条件以留住人才。
logic_chains.example_en: A teacher moving into educational technology may use classroom expertise while gaining new technical skills.
logic_chains.result_en: Better matching can raise motivation and long-term productivity.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 频繁无计划跳槽会损害技能积累和稳定关系。

logic_chains.title_zh: 工作意义不能取代基本保障
logic_chains.claim_en: Meaningful work is valuable only when pay, safety and predictability meet a reasonable floor.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 个人使命感能增强投入，但不能成为企业降低保障的理由。
logic_chains.example_en: Charity staff may accept modest salaries, yet still need secure contracts and manageable workloads.
logic_chains.result_en: Combining purpose with fair conditions makes commitment sustainable.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 不同人生阶段对收入、弹性与意义的权重会变化。

topics.summary_zh: 判断技术提高效率与可及性的同时，是否削弱注意力、隐私、能力和真实互动。
topics.framework_zh: 便利与可及性、隐私与依赖、效率提升与人际/能力损耗
topics.stance_zh: 手机和电脑改变了面对面交流的频率，但是否损害能力取决于使用方式，而不是设备本身。
topics.thesis_en: Digital communication can weaken face-to-face skills when it replaces demanding real interaction, although deliberate use can also maintain valuable relationships.
topics.conclusion_en: The sensible response is to design habits and services that use technology for access while preserving situations that require attention, empathy and human judgement.

logic_chains.title_zh: 低摩擦沟通扩大联系
logic_chains.claim_en: Digital tools make communication possible across distance, disability and conflicting schedules.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 异步信息和视频通话降低时间与地理门槛，使弱联系和远距离关系更容易维持。
logic_chains.example_en: A migrant worker can speak with family daily instead of relying on occasional expensive travel.
logic_chains.result_en: Technology can preserve relationships that would otherwise fade.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 连接数量不等于关系质量，仍需投入与回应。

logic_chains.title_zh: 替代真实互动削弱线索读取
logic_chains.claim_en: Face-to-face competence declines when screens remove regular practice in reading tone, pauses and body language.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 文字界面允许延迟和编辑，无法训练即时回应冲突或尴尬的能力。
logic_chains.example_en: A student comfortable in group chats may still struggle to disagree respectfully during a live seminar.
logic_chains.result_en: Heavy substitution can reduce confidence and empathy in complex social settings.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 线上沟通也可作为内向者或残障者的过渡支持。

logic_chains.title_zh: 自动化释放高价值时间
logic_chains.claim_en: Automation improves welfare when it removes repetitive work rather than human judgement.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 机器处理标准流程，人可以集中在解释、照护和创造等高不确定任务。
logic_chains.example_en: An automated appointment system can reduce queues while nurses spend more time with vulnerable patients.
logic_chains.result_en: Productivity gains become meaningful when saved time improves service quality.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 若自动化只用于裁员而不培训员工，收益会分配不均。

logic_chains.title_zh: 数据便利交换隐私与自主
logic_chains.claim_en: Personalised services often depend on collecting data that users cannot meaningfully evaluate.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 信息不对称使用户以短期便利换取长期画像、操控或安全风险。
logic_chains.example_en: A health app may offer useful reminders while sharing sensitive behaviour data with advertisers.
logic_chains.result_en: Clear limits and data minimisation preserve trust without banning useful innovation.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 监管应与风险相称，不能让小型低风险服务承担同样成本。

expressions.zh: 削弱注意力与人际线索

pitfalls_zh: 把‘使用更多’直接推成‘能力消失’，缺少替代机制。
只写方便快捷，没有讨论谁获益、谁被排除。

topics.summary_zh: 分析媒体的公共信息价值、商业激励、隐私边界以及受众判断与监管。
topics.framework_zh: 信息价值、商业动机、受众判断、监管与表达自由
topics.stance_zh: 公众人物应接受与公共角色相关的审视，但名气不构成无限侵犯私人生活的许可。
topics.thesis_en: Celebrities should tolerate scrutiny connected to their public conduct, but fame does not remove their right to a private life unrelated to public interest.
topics.conclusion_en: Media freedom remains legitimate when reporting serves verifiable public interest and respects a clear boundary around private, non-harmful conduct.

logic_chains.title_zh: 公共利益支持必要监督
logic_chains.claim_en: Media scrutiny is justified when private conduct directly contradicts a public responsibility.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 当名人通过信任获利或影响公共决策，其行为可能成为判断诚信与风险的相关证据。
logic_chains.example_en: A public health ambassador secretly promoting unsafe products presents information audiences reasonably need.
logic_chains.result_en: Targeted reporting can protect consumers and hold influential people accountable.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: ‘公众感兴趣’不等于‘公共利益’，普通家庭生活通常不满足标准。

logic_chains.title_zh: 注意力商业制造侵害
logic_chains.claim_en: Intrusive coverage often exists because outrage and intimacy generate clicks rather than civic value.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 广告收入奖励耸动内容，媒体会追逐越界照片、未成年人和猜测性故事。
logic_chains.example_en: Publishing a celebrity's child's location may attract traffic without revealing anything relevant to public duties.
logic_chains.result_en: Unrestrained incentives can cause harassment and normalise privacy violations.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 限制应针对取材方式和可识别伤害，避免成为压制批评的借口。

logic_chains.title_zh: 广告既传递信息也塑造欲望
logic_chains.claim_en: Advertising helps consumers discover options but also manufactures dissatisfaction through repeated comparison.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 信息型广告降低搜索成本，情绪型广告则把身份焦虑与消费绑定。
logic_chains.example_en: A clear price comparison aids choice, whereas edited influencer content may make ordinary lifestyles appear inadequate.
logic_chains.result_en: The effect depends on transparency, audience vulnerability and claim verifiability.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 儿童、医疗和金融广告需要更强保护。

logic_chains.title_zh: 媒介素养提升受众判断
logic_chains.claim_en: Media literacy reduces harm by helping audiences evaluate sources, incentives and missing context.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 识别赞助、核查来源与比较报道能削弱虚假内容的传播优势。
logic_chains.example_en: Students comparing an original study with a sensational headline can see where certainty was exaggerated.
logic_chains.result_en: Better judgement complements regulation because not every misleading message can be removed.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 不能把全部责任推给个人，平台仍掌握分发机制。

topics.summary_zh: 讨论医疗作为基本需求时，市场、政府与个人应分别承担什么责任。
topics.framework_zh: 公共品与市场效率、预防与治疗、政府干预与个人责任
topics.stance_zh: 营利机构可以补充服务与创新，但基本医疗若主要由利润决定，会造成严重的可及性和激励问题。
topics.thesis_en: Private providers can add capacity and innovation, yet the disadvantages outweigh the benefits when access to essential care depends primarily on profitability.
topics.conclusion_en: A mixed system is strongest when public guarantees protect universal access and private participation operates under transparent quality and pricing rules.

logic_chains.title_zh: 支付能力不等于医疗需要
logic_chains.claim_en: A profit-led system allocates treatment according to purchasing power rather than clinical need.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 医疗需求往往突然且无法推迟，患者缺乏普通消费者的选择和议价能力。
logic_chains.example_en: A low-income patient may postpone early cancer screening because the immediate fee is unaffordable.
logic_chains.result_en: Delayed care worsens outcomes and often creates greater emergency costs later.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 非必要、可选择服务可保留更多市场定价空间。

logic_chains.title_zh: 逐利激励扭曲服务结构
logic_chains.claim_en: Providers may favour profitable procedures over prevention and unprofitable community care.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 收益与社会价值不完全一致，慢病管理、偏远地区和健康教育容易供给不足。
logic_chains.example_en: A company may open cosmetic clinics in wealthy districts while rural maternity services remain scarce.
logic_chains.result_en: Resources move away from needs that produce high public value but low private return.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 监管与按结果付费可降低但不能完全消除这种偏差。

logic_chains.title_zh: 竞争可提升效率与创新
logic_chains.claim_en: Regulated competition can shorten waiting times and encourage better service design.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 多元提供者在明确标准下比较成本和体验，能补充公共系统容量。
logic_chains.example_en: Independent diagnostic centres can process routine scans while public hospitals focus on complex cases.
logic_chains.result_en: Patients receive faster care without abandoning universal coverage.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 必须防止挑选低风险患者和不透明加价。

logic_chains.title_zh: 预防需要个人与制度共同作用
logic_chains.claim_en: Healthy behaviour is easier when policy changes the environment surrounding individual choice.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 知识不足、价格、时间和可获得性共同影响饮食与运动，单纯责备个人无效。
logic_chains.example_en: Clear food labels and safer walking routes make informed, active choices more practical.
logic_chains.result_en: Shared responsibility reduces preventable disease without removing autonomy.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 对成瘾、贫困或疾病人群需要支持，不宜使用惩罚性政策。

topics.summary_zh: 连接消费选择、供应链、农业生产与粮食安全，分析浪费从何产生、如何减少。
topics.framework_zh: 供给安全、价格与选择、生产效率、行为激励与制度治理
topics.stance_zh: 食物浪费主要来自低估浪费成本和供应链过度追求充足陈列，解决方案应同时改变价格信息、库存和再分配。
topics.thesis_en: Food waste is driven by distorted incentives at both household and retail levels, so reduction requires better planning, pricing and redistribution rather than awareness campaigns alone.
topics.conclusion_en: Waste falls sustainably when consumers see its real cost and businesses are rewarded for accurate stocking, safe donation and circular use of unavoidable surplus.

logic_chains.title_zh: 低价格与促销弱化浪费感
logic_chains.claim_en: Consumers waste more when promotions make excess purchasing appear cheaper than careful planning.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 多件折扣把单位价格置于实际需求之上，保质期和储存能力被忽略。
logic_chains.example_en: A household may buy three large packs for a discount even though one will expire unopened.
logic_chains.result_en: Small individual losses accumulate into substantial resource and disposal costs.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 对低收入家庭而言批量购买可能合理，措施应提供选择而非取消所有优惠。

logic_chains.title_zh: 零售陈列与预测制造过剩
logic_chains.claim_en: Retailers often overstock because empty shelves are perceived as lost sales.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 不确定需求、外观标准和‘始终充足’的品牌承诺把风险转化为报废。
logic_chains.example_en: A bakery may produce a full range until closing time although late demand is low.
logic_chains.result_en: Better forecasting and late-day pricing can reduce surplus without limiting choice.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 食品安全标准仍须优先，不能为减废延长不安全保质期。

logic_chains.title_zh: 再分配把剩余转为供给
logic_chains.claim_en: Safe surplus can meet social need when donation logistics are reliable.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 责任规则、冷链和数字匹配平台能降低捐赠成本并及时连接机构。
logic_chains.example_en: Supermarkets can list near-expiry produce for local food banks to collect the same evening.
logic_chains.result_en: Redistribution reduces disposal while improving food access.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 捐赠不是过度生产的永久借口，应排在预防之后。

logic_chains.title_zh: 多元农业增强韧性
logic_chains.claim_en: Food security improves when production is diverse enough to absorb climate and trade shocks.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 过度依赖单一进口或作物会让局部中断迅速传导至价格与营养。
logic_chains.example_en: Supporting drought-resistant crops can protect staple supply during repeated dry seasons.
logic_chains.result_en: Resilience may justify targeted support even when the cheapest short-term option is imported food.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 完全自给通常成本高且限制选择，重点应是关键品类和风险。

pitfalls_zh: 只批评消费者，不分析零售和供应链激励。
把所有剩余都假定为安全可捐赠。
讨论粮食自给时忽略成本、气候和贸易分散风险。

topics.summary_zh: 区分隔离、威慑、改造与预防的作用，讨论刑罚比例和社会成因。
topics.framework_zh: 威慑、改造、社会成因、责任主体与比例原则
topics.stance_zh: 监禁对危险罪犯仍必要，但教育、治疗与就业支持更能降低大多数人的再犯风险。
topics.thesis_en: Prison remains necessary for immediate public protection, while education should be the central long-term strategy for rehabilitation and prevention.
topics.conclusion_en: An effective justice system uses proportionate custody where risk requires it and directs far greater attention to the causes that make offending recur.

logic_chains.title_zh: 教育改变合法机会结构
logic_chains.claim_en: Education addresses causes of crime that punishment alone leaves untouched.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 识字、职业技能和财务能力扩大合法收入路径，降低出狱后回到旧网络的压力。
logic_chains.example_en: A prisoner trained in construction can compete for work instead of returning to theft for income.
logic_chains.result_en: Improved reintegration lowers the likelihood of reoffending.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 培训需要雇主接纳与出狱后的持续支持。

logic_chains.title_zh: 监禁隔离即时风险
logic_chains.claim_en: Custody is justified when an offender presents a serious and continuing danger.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 隔离能立即保护潜在受害者，并以比例原则表达社会谴责。
logic_chains.example_en: A violent repeat offender may need secure detention before any course can safely support reform.
logic_chains.result_en: Public safety is preserved while rehabilitation is planned.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 轻微或非暴力犯罪的自动监禁可能强化犯罪网络。

logic_chains.title_zh: 确定性比极端严厉更有威慑
logic_chains.claim_en: The perceived certainty of detection often deters crime more effectively than extreme sentences.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 行为人通常对被抓概率比遥远刑期更敏感，可靠执法改变即时风险计算。
logic_chains.example_en: Visible road policing can reduce dangerous driving even without dramatically increasing penalties.
logic_chains.result_en: Consistent enforcement can prevent offences before punishment is needed.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 执法必须守住程序正义，避免选择性针对。

logic_chains.title_zh: 早期社会预防降低输入
logic_chains.claim_en: Crime prevention is strongest when schools and services intervene before exclusion becomes chronic.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 辍学、成瘾、家庭暴力和缺乏工作机会会叠加，早期支持能切断累积路径。
logic_chains.example_en: Mentoring combined with apprenticeships can give an at-risk teenager status and income outside a gang.
logic_chains.result_en: Fewer people enter the justice system and community safety improves.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 社会解释不能取消个人责任，只影响预防与量刑策略。

pose an immediate threat to the public

只比较惩罚轻重，不区分隔离、威慑和改造。
例子停留在‘罪犯学到技能’，没有写出再犯下降链条。

topics.summary_zh: 用安全、效率、公平和外部成本评估处罚、收费、公共交通与道路设计。
topics.framework_zh: 安全、效率、公平、外部成本与行为改变
topics.stance_zh: 更严厉处罚不是唯一办法；稳定执法、道路设计、培训和替代交通共同决定安全。
topics.thesis_en: Stricter penalties can deter deliberate offences, but road safety improves most through a combined system of enforcement, design, training and viable alternatives to driving.
topics.conclusion_en: Policy should make dangerous behaviour difficult, detection likely and safer choices practical, rather than relying on punishment after harm has occurred.

logic_chains.title_zh: 可靠执法改变风险判断
logic_chains.claim_en: Consistent enforcement deters repeatable offences more effectively than rarely imposed severe penalties.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 驾驶者对即时被查获概率敏感，自动监测和可见执法降低侥幸。
logic_chains.example_en: Average-speed cameras can discourage persistent speeding across an entire road section.
logic_chains.result_en: Risky behaviour falls before a crash occurs.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 监测要透明、可申诉，并避免把罚款变成纯财政工具。

logic_chains.title_zh: 安全设计容错
logic_chains.claim_en: Road design can prevent ordinary human error from becoming fatal.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 隔离车流、减速设施、照明和安全过街点降低冲突速度与暴露。
logic_chains.example_en: Protected cycle lanes reduce the chance that a small steering mistake hits a cyclist.
logic_chains.result_en: Infrastructure protects even when attention or judgement briefly fails.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 改造需依据事故数据，避免无差别降低通行效率。

logic_chains.title_zh: 公共交通提供行为替代
logic_chains.claim_en: Restrictions work better when people have a realistic alternative to private cars.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 可靠公交降低遵守拥堵费、酒驾限制或停车管理的机会成本。
logic_chains.example_en: Late-night buses allow social travel without requiring an intoxicated person to drive.
logic_chains.result_en: Safety and congestion policies become more equitable and acceptable.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 偏远地区需要差异化安排，不能照搬中心城区方案。

logic_chains.title_zh: 分层培训针对高风险
logic_chains.claim_en: Driver education should target novice and repeat-risk groups rather than retest everyone identically.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 风险随经验、年龄、车辆和违法记录变化，资源应集中在可预测的薄弱环节。
logic_chains.example_en: Hazard-perception training can help new drivers recognise cyclists before complex junctions.
logic_chains.result_en: Focused training improves skill without imposing unnecessary cost on low-risk drivers.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 培训不能取代车辆标准和道路维护。

topics.title_zh: 城市规划、住房与公共空间
topics.summary_zh: 比较密度、通勤、住房、公共空间和社区联系，判断城市形态如何影响宜居性。
topics.framework_zh: 密度与宜居性、公共空间、通勤效率、发展与保护
topics.stance_zh: 适度垂直发展更适合人口密集城市，但必须配套街道公共空间、交通和家庭型住房。
topics.thesis_en: Compact vertical development is generally more sustainable in large cities, provided that density is matched by public space, transport and liveable building design.
topics.conclusion_en: The best urban form is neither unlimited towers nor unchecked sprawl, but well-connected density that preserves daily access to light, services and community space.

logic_chains.title_zh: 密度缩短基础设施距离
logic_chains.claim_en: Compact development allows more residents to share transport, utilities and nearby services.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 人口集中提高公交频率与设施利用率，并减少长距离道路和管网。
logic_chains.example_en: A high-density district around a metro station can support shops and schools within walking distance.
logic_chains.result_en: Travel time, land consumption and per-person infrastructure costs can fall.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 密度过高且公共服务不足会把效率变成拥挤。

logic_chains.title_zh: 水平扩张提供空间但增加依赖
logic_chains.claim_en: Low-rise neighbourhoods can offer privacy and family space at the cost of longer travel.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 土地用途分散使就业、学校和商业距离拉长，居民更依赖汽车。
logic_chains.example_en: A suburban house may provide a garden while requiring two daily car commutes.
logic_chains.result_en: Private space increases, but congestion and unequal access may worsen.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 轨道交通走廊和混合用途可降低部分扩张成本。

logic_chains.title_zh: 公共空间把密度转为宜居
logic_chains.claim_en: Accessible parks and civic spaces compensate for limited private space in dense neighbourhoods.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 共享绿地提供运动、降温与偶遇机会，使不同年龄和收入群体拥有低成本活动场所。
logic_chains.example_en: A shaded local park can serve children, older residents and workers throughout the day.
logic_chains.result_en: Physical health and neighbourhood trust improve together.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 空间必须安全、可达并有维护，地图上的绿地不等于实际使用。

logic_chains.title_zh: 住房组合维持社会多样性
logic_chains.claim_en: A city needs varied housing sizes and tenures to prevent displacement and segregation.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 只建高端小户型会排除家庭和低收入劳动者，拉长通勤并削弱社区稳定。
logic_chains.example_en: Including affordable family units near jobs allows teachers and service workers to remain in the district.
logic_chains.result_en: Mixed communities support both economic function and social continuity.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 可负担住房政策需防止质量下降和永久财政失控。

expressions.zh: 防止低收入居民被迫迁离

topics.summary_zh: 讨论环境问题中个人、企业与政府的能力差异，以及成本、时间尺度和协同行动。
topics.framework_zh: 代际责任、外部性、个人/企业/政府协同、成本与可行性
topics.stance_zh: 政府和大型企业影响最大，但个人通过需求、投票和社区规范仍能推动或阻碍系统变化。
topics.thesis_en: Governments and major firms control the largest levers of environmental change, yet individual behaviour remains necessary because it shapes demand, legitimacy and social norms.
topics.conclusion_en: Environmental progress is therefore a coordinated process: institutions redesign the system while citizens make the cleaner system politically durable and commercially viable.

logic_chains.title_zh: 制度掌握高杠杆基础设施
logic_chains.claim_en: Governments can change the default options available to millions of people.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 能源、交通和建筑标准由制度设定，个人无法独立替换电网或城市路网。
logic_chains.example_en: A clean-electricity standard can reduce emissions from every household connected to the grid.
logic_chains.result_en: One policy change produces scale that isolated consumer choices cannot match.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 政策要设过渡期与补偿，避免成本集中在低收入群体。

logic_chains.title_zh: 企业决定产品全生命周期
logic_chains.claim_en: Large firms shape environmental impact through design, sourcing and supply chains.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 产品是否耐用、可修复、低碳，往往在消费者购买前已经决定。
logic_chains.example_en: A manufacturer that redesigns packaging can remove tonnes of plastic without asking each buyer to sort it later.
logic_chains.result_en: Upstream changes prevent waste and emissions at source.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 自愿承诺需有可核验指标，否则容易变成绿色营销。

logic_chains.title_zh: 个人需求改变商业可行性
logic_chains.claim_en: Consumer and voter choices influence whether environmental policies and products endure.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 持续需求形成市场规模，投票与社区行动给政府提供执行授权。
logic_chains.example_en: Regular use of public transport can justify higher service frequency, which then attracts more users.
logic_chains.result_en: Individual action can trigger reinforcing institutional change.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 不能把系统问题道德化为个人是否完美环保。

logic_chains.title_zh: 跨国问题需要协调
logic_chains.claim_en: Pollution and climate risks cross borders, so unilateral action can be undermined by leakage.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 生产可能迁往监管较弱地区，河流、空气和碳排放也不受国界限制。
logic_chains.example_en: Shared carbon standards can prevent firms from gaining an advantage by relocating dirty production.
logic_chains.result_en: Cooperation protects ambition while distributing monitoring and finance.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 国际协议仍需国内执行与透明问责。

topics.title_en: Waste, Consumption and the Circular Economy
topics.summary_zh: 分析一次性消费的商业激励、产品寿命和回收体系，优先讨论源头减量。
topics.framework_zh: 消费诱因、生命周期成本、生产者责任、回收激励
topics.stance_zh: 抛弃型社会源于低价、快速更新和维修困难，应通过耐用设计、维修权与生产者责任改变产品生命周期。
topics.thesis_en: Throw-away consumption is driven by cheap replacement and short product lives, so policy should make durability, repair and recovery economically rational.
topics.conclusion_en: A circular economy begins by preventing unnecessary turnover and then ensures that unavoidable waste returns safely to productive use.

logic_chains.title_zh: 低价隐藏生命周期成本
logic_chains.claim_en: Cheap replacement encourages consumers to ignore the resource and disposal cost of short-lived goods.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 原材料、运输与填埋成本不完全体现在售价中，替换看似比维修更划算。
logic_chains.example_en: A low-cost appliance may be discarded after one failed component because repair costs almost as much as a new unit.
logic_chains.result_en: Consumption rises while material value is lost after brief use.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 耐用产品初始价格较高，需要标签和融资避免排除低收入消费者。

logic_chains.title_zh: 不可维修设计锁定丢弃
logic_chains.claim_en: Products become waste prematurely when parts, manuals and software support are unavailable.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 专用螺丝、粘合结构和配件停产使小故障无法修复。
logic_chains.example_en: A phone with a sealed battery may be replaced although every other component still works.
logic_chains.result_en: Right-to-repair rules can extend product life and create local service jobs.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 安全关键设备仍需认证维修。

logic_chains.title_zh: 生产者责任改变设计激励
logic_chains.claim_en: Making producers fund collection and recovery rewards products that are easier to reuse.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 企业承担报废成本后，会更重视材料单一化、可拆解和回收网络。
logic_chains.example_en: A packaging fee linked to recyclability can make refillable containers financially attractive.
logic_chains.result_en: Waste prevention becomes a design objective rather than a municipal afterthought.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 费用必须透明，避免企业简单转嫁而不改变产品。

logic_chains.title_zh: 回收是末端而非万能方案
logic_chains.claim_en: Recycling preserves value only when materials are clean, separable and supported by real demand.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 复杂混合材料和污染会降低回收率，即使消费者正确分类也可能无法处理。
logic_chains.example_en: Separating food waste from paper can keep fibres usable and produce compost from organics.
logic_chains.result_en: Well-designed systems reduce landfill but cannot justify unlimited consumption.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 优先级应是减少、重复使用、维修，再到回收。

expressions.en: extend the useful life of products
make manufacturers responsible for end-of-life waste
expressions.zh: 让生产者承担报废责任

expressions.en: prioritise reduction and reuse over recycling
expressions.zh: 优先减量与重复使用而非回收

pitfalls_zh: 把循环经济等同于垃圾分类。

默认所有标注可回收的材料都会真实回收。

topics.title_zh: 动物保护与生物多样性
topics.summary_zh: 区分动物福利、物种保护和生态系统价值，在资源有限时建立优先级。
topics.framework_zh: 生态价值、资源优先级、动物权利与人类利益
topics.stance_zh: 物种下降主要由栖息地破坏和资源过度利用造成，治理应优先保护生态系统并针对关键物种恢复。
topics.thesis_en: Biodiversity loss is primarily a consequence of habitat destruction and overexploitation, so solutions must protect ecosystems while targeting the species most important to ecological recovery.
topics.conclusion_en: Conservation succeeds when law, local livelihoods and scientific monitoring make living ecosystems more valuable than their short-term destruction.

logic_chains.title_zh: 栖息地破坏放大多物种损失
logic_chains.claim_en: Habitat loss harms entire ecological networks rather than one visible species at a time.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 道路、农业和城市扩张切碎繁殖地与迁徙路线，使种群即使未被猎杀也难以恢复。
logic_chains.example_en: A road through a wetland can isolate amphibian populations and alter the water system used by birds and fish.
logic_chains.result_en: Protecting connected habitats produces broader returns than isolated rescue efforts.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 必要基础设施可通过绕行、生态廊道和补偿降低损害。

logic_chains.title_zh: 过度利用超过再生速度
logic_chains.claim_en: Wild populations decline when extraction exceeds their reproductive capacity.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 捕捞、狩猎和贸易在监管薄弱时把短期收入置于长期存量之上。
logic_chains.example_en: Seasonal catch limits can allow a fish population to reproduce before commercial harvest resumes.
logic_chains.result_en: Science-based limits preserve both biodiversity and future livelihoods.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 贫困社区需要替代收入，否则禁令难以执行。

logic_chains.title_zh: 关键物种产生系统外溢
logic_chains.claim_en: Protecting keystone species can stabilise many other parts of an ecosystem.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 捕食者、授粉者或造林动物改变食物网和栖息地结构，保护效益超出单个物种。
logic_chains.example_en: Restoring pollinator habitats can support wild plants as well as nearby agriculture.
logic_chains.result_en: Conservation spending can deliver ecological and economic co-benefits.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 优先关键物种不代表忽略普通物种的整体栖息地。

logic_chains.title_zh: 社区利益决定长期执行
logic_chains.claim_en: Conservation is more durable when local people share its economic and cultural benefits.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 如果保护只带来限制，偷猎与土地冲突会持续；就业、收益分成和产权可改变激励。
logic_chains.example_en: Community-managed tourism can fund rangers while giving residents income from living wildlife.
logic_chains.result_en: Local stewardship improves compliance and monitoring.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 旅游承载力必须受控，避免保护本身制造干扰。

expressions.en: exceed the reproductive capacity of a species

expressions.zh: 让保护与当地生计一致

pitfalls_zh: 把动物福利和物种保护混为一谈。
只写‘动物也有权利’，没有生态或执行机制。
提出全面禁令却不给当地社区替代生计。

Human activities have a negative effect on plants and animal species. Some people think that it is too late to do anything about this problem. Other people believe that effective measures can be taken to improve this situation. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Many believe that it is important to protect all wild animals, while others think that it is important to protect some, not all of them. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

topics.title_zh: 全球化、移民与文化认同
topics.summary_zh: 讨论跨境产品、人口与文化内容如何带来选择、融合、同质化和身份焦虑。
topics.framework_zh: 融合与多样性、经济便利与身份流失、适应与包容
topics.stance_zh: 进口影视扩大选择和交流，但应通过投资人才与发行渠道支持本土创作，而不是用封锁保护文化。
topics.thesis_en: Imported films broaden cultural choice, while sustained investment in domestic production is necessary to preserve local voices and creative capacity.
topics.conclusion_en: Cultural confidence grows through the ability to create and compete, not through isolation from foreign work.

logic_chains.title_zh: 进口内容扩大文化视野
logic_chains.claim_en: Foreign media exposes audiences to unfamiliar experiences, values and storytelling traditions.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 跨文化叙事降低陌生感并提供比较自身社会的新参照。
logic_chains.example_en: A locally subtitled drama can help viewers understand family expectations in another country.
logic_chains.result_en: Exposure can increase empathy and creative experimentation.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 平台推荐不应让少数全球作品挤占所有可见度。

logic_chains.title_zh: 本土生产维持表达能力
logic_chains.claim_en: Domestic film industries preserve the capacity to tell stories rooted in local language and memory.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 若资金、培训和院线全部依赖进口，本地创作者难以形成持续职业路径。
logic_chains.example_en: Public grants for first films can help regional-language directors reach national audiences.
logic_chains.result_en: A living industry keeps cultural identity adaptable rather than merely ceremonial.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 资助应竞争透明并以质量、受众和多样性评估。

logic_chains.title_zh: 移民融合需要双向适应
logic_chains.claim_en: Integration works when newcomers learn shared civic norms and institutions remain open to legitimate difference.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 共同语言与法律建立合作底线，文化空间和反歧视则降低排斥。
logic_chains.example_en: Language classes paired with mixed community projects can build both practical access and local relationships.
logic_chains.result_en: Participation grows without demanding complete cultural erasure.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 伤害他人权利的习俗不能以文化差异免责。

logic_chains.title_zh: 全球产品便利也会同质化
logic_chains.claim_en: Global products lower cost and improve reliability while narrowing visible local variety.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 规模经济让标准商品普及，但连锁网络可能排挤小型生产者与地方设计。
logic_chains.example_en: International food chains offer predictable hygiene, yet independent markets preserve regional ingredients and jobs.
logic_chains.result_en: Competition can benefit consumers if local access and distinctiveness remain viable.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 不应浪漫化所有本土产品，质量与劳动标准仍需评估。

pitfalls_zh: 把文化保护等同于禁止外国内容。
只写多样性好或同质化坏，没有产业与分发机制。
讨论移民时只要求单向适应或完全放任差异。

topics.title_zh: 国际合作、援助与公民责任
topics.title_en: International Cooperation, Aid and Civic Duty
topics.summary_zh: 平衡本地责任与普遍人道需求，评估援助效率、公民义务和制度信任。
topics.framework_zh: 本地优先与普遍责任、公共品、权利义务与执行成本
topics.stance_zh: 慈善机构可以保留明确使命，但紧急援助应以需要程度和自身专业能力为核心，而非国籍。
topics.thesis_en: Charities may maintain a defined mission, but urgent assistance should be guided mainly by severity of need and organisational competence rather than national borders.
topics.conclusion_en: A transparent portfolio that protects core local commitments while reserving capacity for severe crises offers the most defensible balance.

logic_chains.title_zh: 极端需要产生普遍责任
logic_chains.claim_en: Severe and preventable suffering creates a moral claim that is not erased by national borders.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 当少量资源能避免死亡或流离失所时，只以国籍排除援助很难辩护。
logic_chains.example_en: A medical charity with disaster expertise can save lives abroad after an earthquake without abandoning its normal local programmes.
logic_chains.result_en: Aid is directed where marginal impact is greatest.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 机构必须在自身能力范围内行动，善意不能替代专业。

logic_chains.title_zh: 本地信任支撑持续捐赠
logic_chains.claim_en: A visible local commitment can strengthen donor trust and long-term funding.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 捐赠者了解本地问题并期待可追踪结果，完全偏离使命会削弱合法性。
logic_chains.example_en: A community housing charity may reserve most funds for local homelessness while contributing expertise to an emergency coalition.
logic_chains.result_en: Clear allocation protects both accountability and wider solidarity.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 本地优先不能成为忽视灾难级需求的绝对规则。

logic_chains.title_zh: 透明度提高援助质量
logic_chains.claim_en: Aid becomes effective when organisations publish objectives, costs and measurable outcomes.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 信息公开减少重复项目、行政浪费与短期形象工程。
logic_chains.example_en: Reporting vaccination cost and coverage allows donors to compare programmes rather than rely on emotional advertising.
logic_chains.result_en: Resources shift toward interventions with credible impact.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 不能只用易量化指标忽略尊严、制度能力等长期价值。

logic_chains.title_zh: 公民义务换取公共能力
logic_chains.claim_en: Taxes and civic duties finance services that individuals cannot reliably provide alone.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 公共卫生、司法和基础设施需要稳定集体筹资，搭便车会削弱共同保障。
logic_chains.example_en: Broad tax participation funds clean water systems that protect contributors and non-contributors alike.
logic_chains.result_en: Shared obligations sustain rights and public trust.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 义务必须依法、公平并伴随政府问责。

expressions.en: allocate aid according to severity of need
expressions.zh: 按需要严重程度分配援助
在经验证的专业能力内行动
维持捐赠者信任与问责
产生可衡量的人道影响

expressions.en: share the duties that sustain public goods
expressions.zh: 共同承担维系公共品的义务

pitfalls_zh: 把‘先帮本国’或‘全球援助’写成无条件绝对命题。
只谈爱心，不讨论机构能力、成本和问责。
讨论公民义务时只写服从，不写权利与政府责任。

It is impossible to help all people in the world, so governments should focus on people in their own countries. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

As we face more and more problems affecting the whole planet, good relationships between different countries are becoming more important than ever before. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Rich countries often give money to poorer countries, but it does not solve poverty. Therefore, developed countries should give other types of help to poor countries rather than financial aid. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Many of today's most urgent problems can only be solved by international cooperation. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Some people think that charity organizations should only help people in their own country. However, others believe these organizations should aid people in great need wherever they live. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Some people think that the main benefit of international cooperation is in the protection of the environment, while others believe that businesses mainly benefit. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
Some people think that paying taxes is their only duty, while others believe that we have more responsibilities towards society. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
Some people think it is better to have one single legal system worldwide, while others say countries should have their own laws. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
As well as making money, businesses also have a responsibility towards society. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

topics.title_zh: 艺术价值、文化资助与遗产
topics.summary_zh: 评估文化的公共价值、市场失灵、历史归属，以及保护与现实使用之间的关系。
topics.framework_zh: 公共文化价值、市场失灵、身份记忆、保护与发展
topics.stance_zh: 具有核心身份和非法取得证据的文物应优先归还，其余可通过长期借展、共同研究和数字开放共享。
topics.thesis_en: Museums should return objects with strong cultural significance and unjust acquisition histories, while using partnerships and long-term loans for more ambiguous cases.
topics.conclusion_en: Repatriation is strongest when it restores legitimate ownership and expands knowledge through cooperation rather than simply moving collections behind new barriers.

logic_chains.title_zh: 来源正义决定归还强度
logic_chains.claim_en: Objects removed through coercion or illegal excavation carry a strong claim for restitution.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 所有权问题不能被后来的展示价值完全覆盖，归还也能修复机构信任。
logic_chains.example_en: A sacred object seized during colonial rule may remain central to the living rituals of its community of origin.
logic_chains.result_en: Return restores agency and can support cultural continuity.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 合法购买且归属复杂的物品需要个案证据，而非一刀切。

logic_chains.title_zh: 合作保留全球可及性
logic_chains.claim_en: Shared curation and long-term loans can preserve international access after ownership is resolved.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 联合展览、研究和数字化让知识流动不依赖永久占有。
logic_chains.example_en: A returned sculpture can tour partner museums with bilingual interpretation and shared conservation work.
logic_chains.result_en: More audiences gain context while origin communities retain authority.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 合作不能成为无限拖延明确归还的手段。

logic_chains.title_zh: 公共资助纠正市场失灵
logic_chains.claim_en: Public funding supports cultural work whose social value exceeds its ticket revenue.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 实验艺术、地方语言和文物保护产生教育与身份收益，却可能缺乏商业规模。
logic_chains.example_en: A regional theatre programme can preserve dialect and train young performers despite modest box-office income.
logic_chains.result_en: Funding keeps cultural ecosystems diverse and accessible.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 资助要透明、多元，避免政治偏好决定创作内容。

logic_chains.title_zh: 活化利用支持长期保护
logic_chains.claim_en: Heritage survives more sustainably when buildings have compatible contemporary uses.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 合理使用带来维护资金与日常关注，空置的纯保护对象反而更易衰败。
logic_chains.example_en: A historic station converted into a library can retain structure while serving present residents.
logic_chains.result_en: Conservation becomes economically and socially durable.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 改造必须可逆并保护关键历史特征。

expressions.en: establish a legitimate claim to restitution

expressions.zh: 通过共同策展保持可及性

expressions.en: correct a failure of the commercial market
give heritage a compatible modern use
expressions.zh: 赋予遗产相容的现代用途

pitfalls_zh: 只用‘属于原国家’判断所有权，忽略取得方式与文化联系。
把艺术价值缩减为旅游收入。
支持资助却不给透明分配和艺术独立边界。

These days, many people like to watch live performances (such as shows or concerts) at home, either on TV or on a computer, instead of attending in person. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh its disadvantages?

The restoration of old buildings in major cities in the world involves a lot of government expenditures. This money should be used for new housing and road development. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people claim that public museums and art galleries will not be needed because people can see historical objects and works of art using a computer. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Museums and art galleries should concentrate on local works rather than showing the cultures or artworks from other countries. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Music has been and will continue to be the universal language of mankind. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Historical objects in museums all over the world should be returned to their country of origin. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
It is better to learn the way people lived in the past through films and video records than written documents. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Museums and historical sites are mainly visited by local people. Why is this the case? What can be done to encourage local people to visit these sites?
In today's world of advanced science and technology, we still greatly value our artists such as musicians, painters and writers. What can arts tell us about life that science and technology cannot?

Some people say that anyone can create art, such as painting, poetry, music, and so on. Others think that a person should have special abilities to create art. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

topics.title_zh: 体育价值、商业化与公共投入
topics.summary_zh: 区分大众参与、精英竞技、商业收入和公共资金的不同目标与受益者。
topics.framework_zh: 大众参与与精英成绩、商业资金、榜样作用与公平
topics.stance_zh: 体育商业化带来资源与职业机会，但当收入挤压公平竞赛和大众参与时需要更强治理。
topics.thesis_en: The commercial growth of sport is broadly positive when revenue improves competition and participation, but harmful when financial power overwhelms integrity and access.
topics.conclusion_en: Commercial success should fund a wider sporting ecosystem while transparent rules protect athletes, supporters and fair competition.

logic_chains.title_zh: 收入提升训练与传播
logic_chains.claim_en: Commercial revenue can finance professional coaching, facilities and global coverage.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 转播、赞助和门票让运动员形成职业路径，并提高赛事质量。
logic_chains.example_en: Broadcast income can fund medical teams and youth academies that small gate receipts could not support.
logic_chains.result_en: Sport becomes safer, more visible and economically viable.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 收益分配若只集中于明星和少数俱乐部，系统基础仍会薄弱。

logic_chains.title_zh: 金钱可能破坏竞赛完整性
logic_chains.claim_en: Unequal financial power can distort recruitment, scheduling and sporting priorities.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 富裕组织囤积人才，赞助商推动过密赛程，短期娱乐价值压过运动员健康与公平。
logic_chains.example_en: A league dominated by two wealthy clubs may lose uncertainty and long-term audience trust.
logic_chains.result_en: Governance rules are needed to protect the product commercialisation depends on.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 收入限制要尊重劳动权益并避免僵化。

logic_chains.title_zh: 公共投入应优先大众参与
logic_chains.claim_en: Public money produces broader health returns when it removes barriers to everyday participation.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 社区场地、学校项目和低价课程覆盖更多人，降低健康不平等。
logic_chains.example_en: A network of local swimming lessons may benefit thousands more residents than one elite stadium.
logic_chains.result_en: Participation spending combines health, inclusion and talent discovery.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 少量精英投资可带动技术、榜样和国家赛事，但需证明外溢收益。

logic_chains.example_en: A medal campaign linked to free school clubs can convert visibility into sustained activity.

logic_chains.boundary_zh: 不能假设每位明星都应承担教育者责任。

topics.summary_zh: 比较公共与私人科研的激励、时间尺度、风险承受和知识外溢。
topics.framework_zh: 长期创新与现实民生、公共/私人研发、风险与外溢收益
topics.stance_zh: 私人公司能提高速度与应用效率，但基础研究、透明度和公共利益仍需要政府投资与规则。
topics.thesis_en: Privately funded research can accelerate useful innovation, but its advantages outweigh the risks only when public institutions protect openness, safety and neglected long-term research.
topics.conclusion_en: A mixed research system combines commercial discipline with public investment in knowledge whose value is broad, uncertain or too distant for the market alone.

logic_chains.title_zh: 商业激励加速应用
logic_chains.claim_en: Private firms can move quickly when research has a clear user need and route to market.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 资本、专业团队和客户反馈集中决策，减少从实验到产品的延迟。
logic_chains.example_en: A medical-device company can refine a low-cost sensor through repeated clinical and manufacturing trials.
logic_chains.result_en: Useful discoveries reach users faster and create further investment.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 速度必须服从独立安全审查，尤其涉及健康和环境。

logic_chains.title_zh: 利润忽略公共高价值问题
logic_chains.claim_en: Markets underinvest in research whose benefits are diffuse or difficult to capture.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 基础知识、罕见病和长期环境监测可能惠及社会，却无法形成足够短期回报。
logic_chains.example_en: Decades of publicly funded climate records support farmers, insurers and scientists without one firm owning the benefit.
logic_chains.result_en: Public funding preserves a pipeline of shared knowledge.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 政府项目也需同行评审、阶段评估和公开失败。

logic_chains.title_zh: 开放科学扩大外溢收益
logic_chains.claim_en: Research creates more value when methods and findings can be tested and reused.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 透明数据促进复现、纠错和跨领域应用，降低重复成本。
logic_chains.example_en: Publishing a standard battery-testing dataset can help many teams compare safer materials.
logic_chains.result_en: Knowledge accumulates faster and public trust improves.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 商业机密可有期限保护，但不应遮蔽安全风险或伪造结果。

logic_chains.title_zh: 太空研究需与民生组合评估
logic_chains.claim_en: Large scientific missions are justified by long-term spillovers rather than spectacle alone.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 太空项目推动材料、通信和观测能力，但机会成本要求清晰目标。
logic_chains.example_en: Earth-observation satellites can improve disaster warnings and crop monitoring as well as scientific knowledge.
logic_chains.result_en: High-cost research can generate broad civilian returns.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 预算应分阶段并与更直接的公共需求保持比例。

pitfalls_zh: 只比较谁出钱，没有分析科研类型和回报时间。

topics.title_zh: 贫富差距、薪酬与社会公平
topics.summary_zh: 分析薪酬激励、机会、公平感、税收和过度集中的社会影响。
topics.framework_zh: 激励与分配、公平感、人才竞争、税收与薪酬约束
topics.stance_zh: 高薪可以奖励稀缺贡献，但硬性最高工资容易失真；累进税、透明治理和最低保障更有效。
topics.thesis_en: Very high pay can reward scarce responsibility, but progressive taxation, governance and a strong wage floor are preferable to an absolute salary ceiling.
topics.conclusion_en: The goal should be to preserve productive incentives while preventing extreme rewards from reflecting power, opacity or rent-seeking rather than genuine contribution.

logic_chains.title_zh: 稀缺责任可支持薪酬差异
logic_chains.claim_en: High salaries can attract people to roles involving rare skills, pressure and large consequences.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 人才供给有限且决策影响巨大时，竞争性薪酬降低关键岗位空缺。
logic_chains.example_en: A specialist surgeon or turnaround manager may create value far beyond an average role.
logic_chains.result_en: Pay differences can support recruitment and effort where contribution is credible.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 不能把职位头衔自动等同于贡献，需有透明绩效与长期责任。

logic_chains.title_zh: 权力与不透明制造过度薪酬
logic_chains.claim_en: Executive pay can rise through bargaining power and weak oversight rather than productivity.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 管理层影响董事会、指标偏短期，薪酬与普通员工或长期结果脱节。
logic_chains.example_en: A bonus tied to one year's share price may reward cost-cutting that damages future capability.
logic_chains.result_en: Extreme gaps can weaken trust and distort corporate decisions.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 监管应改善治理和披露，不宜由政府逐笔决定工资。

logic_chains.title_zh: 累进税兼顾激励与再分配
logic_chains.claim_en: Progressive taxation recovers part of exceptional income without fixing every salary in advance.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 税制保留追加努力的收益，同时为教育、医疗和基础设施筹资。
logic_chains.example_en: A higher marginal rate can fund early education that expands opportunity for lower-income children.
logic_chains.result_en: Inequality is moderated through public capacity rather than a rigid market ban.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 税率过高、漏洞众多或跨境协调不足会削弱效果。

logic_chains.title_zh: 机会公平比结果完全相同更可持续
logic_chains.claim_en: A fair society should narrow inherited barriers before attempting to equalise every outcome.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 教育、健康和法律机会影响竞争起点，完全压平结果则可能削弱选择与创新。
logic_chains.example_en: Need-based scholarships can let capable students compete without guaranteeing identical lifetime earnings.
logic_chains.result_en: Mobility and legitimacy improve while effort remains meaningful.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 机会政策也要监测真实结果，否则形式平等可能掩盖持续障碍。

topics.summary_zh: 评估企业增长方法、利益相关者责任、长期信任与监管边界。
topics.framework_zh: 利润与社会责任、市场效率、利益相关者与监管
topics.stance_zh: 提高销量最有效的方式不是单纯扩大广告，而是改善产品价值并用可信信息降低顾客决策成本。
topics.thesis_en: The most durable way to increase sales is to improve customer value and trust, with promotion serving as evidence-based communication rather than a substitute for product quality.
topics.conclusion_en: Sustainable growth follows when acquisition, repeat purchase and reputation reinforce one another instead of being purchased temporarily through pressure or deception.

logic_chains.title_zh: 产品价值驱动重复购买
logic_chains.claim_en: Improving product reliability and usefulness generates repeat demand without repeatedly buying attention.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 真实体验形成留存、口碑和更低退换成本，使增长具有累积性。
logic_chains.example_en: A software firm that simplifies onboarding may keep more users than one spending the same budget on celebrity advertising.
logic_chains.result_en: Customer lifetime value and reputation rise together.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 质量改进要以用户需求为准，过度功能也会增加成本。

logic_chains.title_zh: 可信传播降低搜索成本
logic_chains.claim_en: Clear marketing helps customers compare a product with relevant alternatives.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 具体功能、价格和适用场景减少不确定性，促成更匹配的购买。
logic_chains.example_en: A verified energy-cost comparison can persuade appliance buyers more effectively than vague claims of superiority.
logic_chains.result_en: Better-matched customers are less likely to return products or feel misled.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 披露必须可核验，不能利用信息不对称。

logic_chains.title_zh: 价格促销适合短期试用
logic_chains.claim_en: Targeted discounts can overcome the risk of trying an unfamiliar product.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 有限优惠降低首次体验门槛，并为企业获取反馈。
logic_chains.example_en: A short free trial allows a small business to test accounting software before switching systems.
logic_chains.result_en: Trials can start a relationship that quality later sustains.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 长期折扣会训练顾客等待低价并伤害品牌。

logic_chains.title_zh: 利益相关者责任保护经营基础
logic_chains.claim_en: Corporate responsibility protects the employees, communities and environment on which long-term profit depends.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 压低安全和环境成本可能提升季度利润，却增加事故、监管和信任风险。
logic_chains.example_en: A manufacturer that audits suppliers can prevent labour abuse and sudden supply disruption.
logic_chains.result_en: Ethical practice becomes risk management as well as a social obligation.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 企业不能替代政府，但必须承担与自身影响相称的责任。

topics.title_zh: 家庭结构、生育与性别角色
topics.title_en: Family Structure, Parenthood and Gender Roles
topics.summary_zh: 讨论生育时点、照护分工、性别机会与家庭选择如何受经济和制度影响。
topics.framework_zh: 性别分工、照护成本、机会平等与人口影响
topics.stance_zh: 晚育通常提高经济与心理准备，但生育风险和代际照护压力要求更友好的家庭政策。
topics.thesis_en: Later parenthood often improves financial and emotional readiness, but its benefits outweigh the costs only when families can manage fertility, care and intergenerational pressure.
topics.conclusion_en: The trend should be supported through informed choice and family-friendly institutions rather than judged as either selfish delay or automatic progress.

logic_chains.title_zh: 教育与职业推迟生育
logic_chains.claim_en: Longer education and insecure early careers lead adults to postpone parenthood until life feels stable.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 住房、照护和机会成本较高时，人们会先建立收入与关系基础。
logic_chains.example_en: A couple may wait until both partners complete training and secure predictable work before having a child.
logic_chains.result_en: Later timing can reduce financial stress and improve planned caregiving.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 稳定并非完美条件，政策不能让普通家庭无限等待。

logic_chains.title_zh: 成熟与资源改善养育质量
logic_chains.claim_en: Older parents may bring greater patience, savings and relationship stability to childcare.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 积累的生活经验和经济缓冲降低冲突，并允许投入时间与教育资源。
logic_chains.example_en: Parents with flexible established careers may share leave without risking immediate job loss.
logic_chains.result_en: Children can receive more consistent care and a calmer home environment.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 年龄本身不保证良好养育，健康和支持网络同样重要。

logic_chains.title_zh: 生育风险与代际压力增加
logic_chains.claim_en: Delaying childbirth can narrow fertility options and concentrate care responsibilities later in life.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 父母可能同时照顾幼儿和年迈祖辈，医疗风险与时间压力叠加。
logic_chains.example_en: A first-time parent in their forties may face infant care while coordinating support for elderly parents.
logic_chains.result_en: Private stress can become demand for health and care services.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 不能夸大风险；现代医疗与多样家庭路径能缓解部分问题。

logic_chains.title_zh: 平等照护扩大双方机会
logic_chains.claim_en: Shared parental leave reduces the career penalty associated with motherhood.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 男性参与照护使雇主不再把育儿成本只绑定女性，也增强父子关系。
logic_chains.example_en: Non-transferable paid leave for fathers can normalise temporary absence across genders.
logic_chains.result_en: Household care and labour-market opportunity become more balanced.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 政策要保证收入替代，否则低薪父亲可能无法使用。

topics.summary_zh: 分析寿命延长对养老金、劳动、医疗、家庭照护和社会参与的影响。
topics.framework_zh: 财政负担、劳动供给、数字融入、家庭与公共照护
topics.stance_zh: 更长退休期会增加收入与照护压力，应以弹性退休、终身储蓄和社区照护分担风险。
topics.thesis_en: Longer lives after retirement create financial and care pressures, which are best addressed through flexible work, sustainable pensions and community-based support.
topics.conclusion_en: Ageing should be treated as a predictable life-course transition: institutions must spread costs while enabling older people to retain choice, skills and social participation.

logic_chains.title_zh: 退休期延长加重收入风险
logic_chains.claim_en: A longer retirement period can outlast savings and place sustained pressure on pension systems.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 缴费年限未同步增长时，每位劳动者需要支持更长领取期。
logic_chains.example_en: A person retiring at sixty may need income for three further decades rather than fifteen years.
logic_chains.result_en: Without adjustment, poverty risk or intergenerational tax pressure rises.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 低寿命和高体力职业需要更早退出保障，不能统一延迟。

logic_chains.title_zh: 弹性工作保留能力与收入
logic_chains.claim_en: Flexible retirement allows willing older adults to contribute without demanding full-time endurance.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 兼职、顾问和岗位调整能保留经验，同时减轻养老金依赖和身份骤变。
logic_chains.example_en: An experienced nurse might mentor new staff for two days a week rather than continue night shifts.
logic_chains.result_en: Labour supply and wellbeing improve together.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 延长工作必须自愿，并防止年龄歧视和收入惩罚。

logic_chains.title_zh: 社区照护延缓高成本机构化
logic_chains.claim_en: Accessible local care helps older people remain independent for longer.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 家庭医生、日间中心、居家改造与交通能在危机前解决小需求。
logic_chains.example_en: Regular home visits can identify medication or mobility problems before a hospital admission.
logic_chains.result_en: Quality of life improves while acute-care costs are reduced.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 家庭仍可参与，但不应默认女性亲属无偿承担全部照护。

logic_chains.title_zh: 数字融入保护公共参与
logic_chains.claim_en: Digital skills and alternative service channels prevent older citizens from being excluded.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 银行、医疗和政府服务迁移线上后，缺乏设备或信心会转化为实际权利障碍。
logic_chains.example_en: A staffed library clinic can teach secure online booking while retaining a telephone option.
logic_chains.result_en: Older adults gain access without being forced into one channel.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 培训不能成为取消线下支持的借口。

expressions.en: place sustained pressure on pension systems
expressions.zh: 给养老金体系带来持续压力
在全社会分担照护责任

pitfalls_zh: 把老龄化只写成财政负担，忽略经验、消费和参与。
统一提高退休年龄，不考虑健康与职业差异。
把照护责任全部推给家庭或政府。

prompts.prompt: Some believe that younger family members should be legally responsible for supporting older family members when they become physically, mentally, and financially unable to look after themselves. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Training 65-year-olds to use computers would be a good way to use government money. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people say that in the modern world, getting old is entirely bad. Others believe that old people's life nowadays is much better than in the past. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Nowadays, in many countries, young people don't communicate with older people as much as they used to. Why is this happening? How could this situation be improved?
Today, people live longer after retiring from work. What problems does this cause for individuals and society? What can be done to address these problems?

representative_prompt.prompt: Today, people live longer after retiring from work. What problems does this cause for individuals and society? What can be done to address these problems?

topics.summary_zh: 评估旅行的学习、收入与交流收益，以及目的地承载、环境和分配成本。
topics.framework_zh: 个人收益、目的地承载、文化交流与环境/分配成本
topics.stance_zh: 旅行更便利总体积极，但应通过碳定价、游客管理和社区收益分配控制规模成本。
topics.thesis_en: Cheaper international travel is broadly positive because it expands learning and opportunity, provided that environmental and destination costs are properly managed.
topics.conclusion_en: Mobility should remain accessible while prices, capacity limits and local participation make travellers bear the costs they create.

logic_chains.title_zh: 直接接触深化理解
logic_chains.claim_en: Travel can replace abstract stereotypes with direct experience of people and institutions.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 真实互动提供语言、习俗和日常生活的复杂背景，纠正单一媒体印象。
logic_chains.example_en: A student staying with a host family may understand why local meal and work routines differ from those at home.
logic_chains.result_en: Cross-cultural confidence and empathy can grow.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 短暂停留在封闭度假区未必产生真实交流。

logic_chains.title_zh: 游客支出创造地方机会
logic_chains.claim_en: Tourism can diversify income in regions with limited industries.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 住宿、导览、交通和手工艺把外部需求转化为本地就业与税收。
logic_chains.example_en: A community-owned trekking service can fund guides and conservation in a remote village.
logic_chains.result_en: Economic value gives residents a reason to protect local assets.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 若所有权外流，收入可能被跨国平台和地产商吸收。

logic_chains.title_zh: 廉价流动放大碳与拥挤
logic_chains.claim_en: Very low travel prices encourage trips whose private cost excludes environmental and infrastructure damage.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 频繁飞行、短租和峰值人流增加排放、住房压力与公共服务负担。
logic_chains.example_en: Weekend flights to crowded city centres can raise rents while producing little local spending beyond accommodation platforms.
logic_chains.result_en: Unmanaged volume can reduce resident welfare and visitor experience.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 定价要保留必要探亲、学习和低收入者的合理机会。

logic_chains.title_zh: 承载管理保护目的地
logic_chains.claim_en: Capacity controls and local governance can keep tourism within ecological and social limits.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 预约、分时、游客税与分区把人流和收益转向可承受地点。
logic_chains.example_en: A timed-entry system can protect a fragile heritage site and finance maintenance.
logic_chains.result_en: Quality and conservation replace a race for maximum visitor numbers.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 限制应基于数据并防止只有富人能进入。

expressions.zh: 扩大获得国际体验的机会
让旅行者承担环境成本
把旅游收益分配给居民

pitfalls_zh: 把所有旅行都当成深度文化交流。
只写就业数量，不看收入是否留在当地。
环保措施只写禁止或涨价，没有公平和替代。

topics.summary_zh: 评估共同语言的沟通效率与语言多样性的身份、知识和认知价值。
topics.framework_zh: 沟通效率、文化多样性、沉浸体验与媒介替代
topics.stance_zh: 英语作为通用语的收益仍更大，但教育与公共文化政策必须主动保护本地语言。
topics.thesis_en: The spread of English offers substantial communicative and educational benefits, although these gains justify active bilingual policies rather than the passive decline of local languages.
topics.conclusion_en: A global lingua franca and linguistic diversity can coexist when institutions treat additional language learning as expansion, not replacement.

logic_chains.title_zh: 共同语言降低协作成本
logic_chains.claim_en: A shared language allows people from different linguistic backgrounds to exchange knowledge quickly.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 统一沟通媒介减少翻译延迟，并扩大教育、科研和商业网络。
logic_chains.example_en: Researchers from several countries can coordinate a public-health trial using one working language.
logic_chains.result_en: Ideas and opportunities circulate across borders more efficiently.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 共同语言不能成为排除能力较弱者的隐性门槛。

logic_chains.title_zh: 全球教育资源扩大
logic_chains.claim_en: English proficiency opens access to a large body of courses, publications and professional communities.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 学习者可直接使用跨国知识网络，而不必等待本地翻译。
logic_chains.example_en: A rural student can study an open engineering course and join an international discussion forum.
logic_chains.result_en: Access can reduce geographic information disadvantage.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 资源可及还依赖网络、时间和基础教育，语言并非唯一障碍。

logic_chains.title_zh: 语言流失压缩文化知识
logic_chains.claim_en: Local languages carry oral history, ecological knowledge and identity that translation cannot fully preserve.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 词汇、隐喻和表达方式编码特定环境与社会关系，使用者减少会中断代际传递。
logic_chains.example_en: An indigenous language may contain detailed distinctions for local plants absent from a global vocabulary.
logic_chains.result_en: Language loss narrows both cultural diversity and practical knowledge.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 保护不应强迫个人放弃全球语言带来的机会。

logic_chains.title_zh: 加法式双语避免替代
logic_chains.claim_en: Bilingual education can add global competence while maintaining local literacy.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 不同场景配置语言，让学生既能参与国际网络，也能阅读本地历史与公共事务。
logic_chains.example_en: Schools can teach science partly in English while sustaining literature and civic learning in the local language.
logic_chains.result_en: Learners gain wider access without severing cultural continuity.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 课程需避免两种语言都因时间不足而浅表化。

expressions.en: serve as a common working language

pitfalls_zh: 把语言优势只写成旅游方便。
把语言消亡描述为自然过程，忽略学校、就业和媒体激励。
提出保护本地语言却要求排斥英语。

topics.summary_zh: 拆分努力、运气、结构机会、合作与心理福祉，避免把成功归因于单一因素。
topics.framework_zh: 努力与结构条件、竞争激励、合作成本、成就与福祉
topics.stance_zh: 运气影响机会，但持续准备、反馈和环境支持决定人能否把偶然机会转化为成果。
topics.thesis_en: Luck shapes the opportunities people encounter, but preparation, persistence and access to support determine whether those opportunities become lasting achievement.
topics.conclusion_en: Success is best understood as an interaction between agency and circumstance, which preserves personal responsibility without denying unequal starting conditions.

logic_chains.title_zh: 运气影响机会暴露
logic_chains.claim_en: Chance affects timing, networks and events that no individual can fully control.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 出生地、健康、导师和经济周期改变可见机会与失败代价。
logic_chains.example_en: Two equally capable graduates may enter the labour market during very different economic conditions.
logic_chains.result_en: Outcomes can diverge even when effort appears similar.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 承认运气不等于否认选择和准备。

logic_chains.title_zh: 准备把偶然转为能力
logic_chains.claim_en: Preparation determines whether a person can recognise and use an unexpected opportunity.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 长期技能、反馈和习惯形成可调用能力，使机会不只是一时事件。
logic_chains.example_en: A musician invited to perform at short notice succeeds only if years of practice support the moment.
logic_chains.result_en: Effort raises the probability that luck produces durable results.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 努力方向错误或缺乏资源时，单纯投入并不保证回报。

logic_chains.title_zh: 适度竞争提高标准
logic_chains.claim_en: Competition can motivate improvement by making performance and progress visible.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 比较提供目标和反馈，促使个人尝试更有效策略。
logic_chains.example_en: A debating league may encourage students to research more carefully and practise clearer delivery.
logic_chains.result_en: Skills improve when rivalry remains fair and developmental.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 零和排名若决定全部机会，会诱发焦虑和作弊。

logic_chains.title_zh: 合作扩大复杂任务能力
logic_chains.claim_en: Cooperation allows people to combine specialised knowledge that no individual possesses alone.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 分工、互补和批评提高问题解决质量，也建立信任网络。
logic_chains.example_en: A public-health team needs clinicians, statisticians and community workers to design an effective campaign.
logic_chains.result_en: Shared achievement can exceed the sum of individual effort.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 合作仍需清晰责任，避免搭便车和群体思维。

expressions.zh: 把机会转化为持久成就
通过公平竞争提高标准

expressions.en: avoid reducing success to a single cause
expressions.zh: 避免把成功归因于单一原因

pitfalls_zh: 以名人故事证明努力或运气决定一切。
把竞争和合作写成互斥关系。
讨论结构不平等时完全取消个人能动性。

topics.title_zh: 公共服务、财政与政府边界
topics.title_en: Public Services, Taxation and the Role of Government
topics.summary_zh: 判断哪些服务具有基本权利、公共品和风险共担属性，并评估财政可持续性。
topics.framework_zh: 普惠与财政可持续、优先级、市场供给与公平可及
topics.stance_zh: 政府应保障基础医疗和教育，因为其社会外溢巨大；更高层次或可选择服务可由个人与市场共同承担。
topics.thesis_en: Governments should guarantee a strong basic level of health care and education, while allowing private choice beyond that floor under fair regulation.
topics.conclusion_en: Universal foundations protect opportunity and collective resilience, whereas targeted cost-sharing can preserve fiscal capacity for needs the market will not meet.

logic_chains.title_zh: 基础服务产生广泛外溢
logic_chains.claim_en: Education and preventive health create benefits that extend beyond the direct user.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 受教育和健康人口提高生产率、税基与公共安全，市场价格无法收回全部社会收益。
logic_chains.example_en: Vaccination protects vulnerable people who cannot receive the same vaccine themselves.
logic_chains.result_en: Public finance supports outcomes that individual purchasing alone would undersupply.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 并非所有高价治疗或课程都应无限免费。

logic_chains.title_zh: 普惠底线保护机会
logic_chains.claim_en: Universal access prevents income from determining a child's education or a patient's essential treatment.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 风险与家庭背景不由个人选择，基础保障能防止早期劣势永久化。
logic_chains.example_en: A publicly funded primary school gives children a common route into later training and work.
logic_chains.result_en: Mobility and social trust improve when basic institutions are genuinely accessible.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 普惠要包含质量和地域可达，不只是名义免费。

logic_chains.title_zh: 财政约束要求明确优先级
logic_chains.claim_en: Public provision remains credible only when commitments can be financed over time.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 预算用于一项服务就放弃另一机会，长期承诺还受人口和经济变化影响。
logic_chains.example_en: Funding primary care may prevent more suffering per dollar than subsidising every optional procedure.
logic_chains.result_en: Transparent priority-setting protects both impact and public consent.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 成本效益不能成为忽视少数严重疾病的唯一标准。

logic_chains.title_zh: 市场补充提供选择与容量
logic_chains.claim_en: Private provision can add convenience and experimentation beyond a universal public floor.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 自愿付费服务释放部分公共容量，并允许不同偏好得到满足。
logic_chains.example_en: Employers may fund additional professional courses while the state guarantees basic schooling.
logic_chains.result_en: Choice expands without making essential access depend on wealth.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 监管需防止私营部门抽走人才、筛选低风险用户。

expressions.en: generate benefits beyond the direct user
expressions.zh: 产生超出直接使用者的收益
在全体人口中分担风险

expressions.en: allow private provision above the public floor
expressions.zh: 允许市场补充公共底线以上服务

pitfalls_zh: 把政府责任写成所有服务全部免费。
只说税收很高，不比较公共收益和风险共担。
提出市场选择却忽略基本服务中的信息不对称和地域缺口。

topics.title_zh: 社会行为、幸福与生活方式
topics.summary_zh: 解释即时满足、消费压力、闲暇和社会规范如何影响长期福祉与自主选择。
topics.framework_zh: 个人选择、社会压力、心理福祉、规范与自由
topics.stance_zh: 即时服务提高便利，但持续即时满足会削弱耐心、计划与信息判断，整体趋势偏负面。
topics.thesis_en: Instant access is useful for routine needs, but a culture of immediate gratification becomes harmful when it weakens patience, planning and informed judgement.
topics.conclusion_en: The aim is not to reject speed, but to preserve deliberate friction wherever delay protects health, finance, truth or long-term satisfaction.

logic_chains.title_zh: 平台竞争压缩等待
logic_chains.claim_en: Digital platforms compete by removing every pause between desire and fulfilment.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 一键支付、实时推送和即时配送把等待塑造成服务失败，并利用冲动完成交易。
logic_chains.example_en: A shopper can buy an unnecessary item before comparing price, need or return cost.
logic_chains.result_en: Convenience raises consumption while reducing reflective choice.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 紧急服务和无障碍场景中的速度具有真实价值。

logic_chains.title_zh: 即时信息牺牲核验
logic_chains.claim_en: Demand for immediate news rewards speed before accuracy and context.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 媒体与用户都在事实完整前转发，修正往往传播更慢。
logic_chains.example_en: An unverified clip can shape public judgement hours before the full event is known.
logic_chains.result_en: Trust and decision quality decline even when information volume rises.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 延迟机制应针对高风险内容，不应全面限制表达。

logic_chains.title_zh: 延迟满足支持长期目标
logic_chains.claim_en: The ability to tolerate short-term discomfort helps people pursue goals with delayed returns.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 储蓄、学习和健康都需要放弃即时奖励以换取累积收益。
logic_chains.example_en: A student who follows a weekly study plan gains more than one repeatedly switching to quick entertainment.
logic_chains.result_en: Self-regulation expands future choice rather than merely restricting present pleasure.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 过度自律也会损害休息和关系，需要合理弹性。

logic_chains.title_zh: 幸福依赖关系与掌控感
logic_chains.claim_en: Lasting wellbeing depends more on secure relationships and meaningful control than repeated consumption.
logic_chains.mechanism_zh: 新购买带来的情绪适应很快，归属、能力和时间自主则持续影响生活评价。
logic_chains.example_en: Reducing overtime to share regular meals may improve wellbeing more than upgrading another device.
logic_chains.result_en: Policy and personal planning should protect time as well as income.
logic_chains.boundary_zh: 物质安全是基础，不能浪漫化贫困或否定消费改善生活。

pitfalls_zh: 把所有即时服务都批判为懒惰。
幸福题只列金钱、家庭、健康，缺少机制和权衡。
用个人自律解释平台设计与社会压力，责任分配失真。

prompts.prompt: People living in the 21st century have a better quality of life than in the previous centuries. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

An increasing number of people are choosing to have cosmetic surgery in order to improve their appearance. Why do people have operations to change the way they look? Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
It was predicted that people in the 21st century would have much more free time than in the past. To what extent has this prediction come true?
People's shopping habits depend more on the age group they belong to than any other factor. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
The tendency of human beings to copy one another is shown in the popularity of areas such as fashion and consumer goods. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

In many countries, it is becoming easier for people to obtain credit cards, but this also implies higher financial risks. In your opinion, do the advantages of credit cards outweigh the disadvantages?
Today, more and more people want things instantly (e.g. goods, services, news). Why is this the case? Is it a positive or negative development?
